event_title: Measles cases in U.S. by September 30?
required_rule_fragments: specified amount or more confirmed cases of Measles
according to the CDC case counter by September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET
If the counter becomes unavailable, another credible source will be used.
Only cases reported by the CDC Measles (Rubeola) counter will qualify

payoff_identity.package: YES(lower threshold) plus NO(higher threshold) for every ordered lower<higher pair
payoff_identity.proof: the common at-least scalar cannot be below or equal to the lower threshold and above or equal to the higher threshold simultaneously when lower<higher
payoff_identity.price_gate: lower YES bestAsk plus conservative higher NO proxy one minus higher YES bestBid must be strictly below one pUSD
payoff_identity.pair_selection: enumerate all six ordered pairs before ranking with deterministic price then numeric-threshold tie-break
